title: Generative Design Optimizes Cooling Channels for 2.5D and 3D Chips
summary: Researchers published a physics-guided generative design framework for liquid cooling channel topology optimization in multi-chip packages.

title: East West Rail Deploys Thermal Drones for Site Clearance
summary: East West Rail introduced thermal-imaging drones into pre-construction ecological surveys to accelerate site clearance and protect wildlife.

title: 3D Systems and SRNL Partner on Additive Manufacturing
summary: The collaboration will advance materials, AI-enabled process optimization, and workforce training for energy and national security applications.

title: Laser Pulses and X-Rays Reveal Microscale Heat Dissipation Impact
summary: Laser pulses and X-ray imaging reveal the surprising impact of micron-scale material defects on heat dissipation.

title: Sail-Powered Drone Fires Guided Missiles in US Navy Test
summary: The Saildrone Surveyor Unmanned Surface Vessel successfully fired two Joint Air-to-Ground Missiles during a naval exercise.

title: Achieving Long-Cycling Silicon-Based All-Solid-State Batteries
summary: Researchers developed mitigation strategies achieving near-zero stress variation and high capacity retention in silicon-based all-solid-state batteries.

title: First Benchmarks Revealed for OpenAI Jalapeño AI Accelerator
summary: OpenAI detailed Jalapeño, a purpose-built general purpose AI accelerator ASIC designed from scratch for AI workloads.

title: New Machine-Learning Framework Improves Protein Design
summary: A new machine-learning framework aims to improve computational protein design success rates without reproducing natural sequences.

title: Qualcomm Backs Open-Source AI Software to Challenge Nvidia
summary: Modular aims to separate AI software from silicon choice, giving Qualcomm and other challengers a shot at Nvidia-dominated workloads.

title: Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning Benchmark Introduced
summary: Researchers introduce ESRP and ESRP-Bench to evaluate embodied agents on rearranging furniture in 3D scenes using egocentric observations.

title: SpaceX Loads Starship onto Ship in Indian Ocean
summary: SpaceX has loaded Flight 13's Starship upper stage onto a ship in the Indian Ocean for transport back to Texas.

title: Bedrock Robotics Deploys Autonomous Excavators
summary: Bedrock Robotics deploys autonomous excavators to active construction job sites to tackle labor shortages using AI-powered heavy machinery.

title: Goodfire Opens AI Interpretability Platform to Public
summary: Goodfire has released its Silico platform, offering mechanistic interpretability tools to help users peer inside and understand AI model behavior.

title: Earthquake Sensors Record Hurricane Infrasound Signals
summary: Researchers found that seismoacoustic earthquake sensors can detect infrasound and mechanical vibrations produced by turbulent hurricane winds.

title: Lane Electronics Offers Compact Connectors for UAVs
summary: Lane Electronics is supplying Weald Electronics compact LM200 connector systems designed to address the evolving unmanned aerial vehicle market.

title: Nvidia Releases Jetson Orin Nano 2 Computer
summary: Nvidia announced the Jetson Orin Nano 2, an entry-level robotics computer delivering twice the inference performance of the previous Super model.

title: Genesis Recognized for Agentic Data Engineering
summary: The Genesis platform, which operates in customer-managed environments and includes AI agent verification tools, was featured in a Gartner report.

title: VolkerRail Finishes Charing Cross Engineering Programme
summary: VolkerRail completed a 22-day engineering programme during a route closure, allowing Charing Cross and Waterloo East stations to reopen.

title: ASIP Begins OSAT Facility Construction in India
summary: ASIP Technologies has started building a new OSAT facility in Visakhapatnam in partnership with Korean firm APACT.

title: SpaceX Unveils Starbase Spaceport in Louisiana
summary: SpaceX has announced plans for Starbase, Louisiana, described as the largest private spaceport globally.

title: CFD Modelling Cuts Network Rail Bridge Scour Costs
summary: Computational fluid dynamics modelling is improving asset assessment accuracy and reducing bridge scour prevention costs for Network Rail.
